issue.subject: Tickets with history, program or problem context are not auto-resolved
issue.description:
NOC-AUTO S7

**Statement:** As a NOC Manager, I need tickets that were recently remotely resolved, belong to a reseller, or carry a Customer Feedback or Churn AI problem to go to the right team instead of being auto-resolved, so that sensitive cases get human attention.

**PRD:** https://rnd.frontiir.net/en/products/rt/requirements/noc-ticket-automation-prd

**ACs (5):**

- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC24` Remote Resolve within 14 days: When the Local Service ID was remotely resolved within the last 14 days the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC25` Reseller: When the Program field includes Reseller the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC26` Customer Feedback: When Ticket Problem is Customer Feedback the ticket moves to Level2-SbS-Commander with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC27` Churn AI: When Ticket Problem is Churn AI the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC35` Protected Ticket Problem: Ticket Problem is not overwritten when its current value is ChurnAI, Customer Feedback or Installation Error.

**Implementation status:** code exists on the feature branch, unvalidated. Tasks to be refined by Dev after the Story is agreed.

**Related (reference only):** #21613, #22265
